risk_if_not_implemented: Without Physical Security Plan (PSP), unauthorized individuals may gain physical access to facilities and equipment, enabling theft, tampering, damage or safety incidents. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unaddressed Security / Compliance Exposure (R-GV-2), Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Monitoring Physical Access
compensating_control_1.description: Physical access control mechanisms exist to monitor for, detect and respond to physical security incidents.
compensating_control_1.justification: Monitoring Physical Access (PES-13) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Physical Security Plan (PSP) (PES-03) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of enterprise-wide monitoring controls.
